Thank you all for the thorough updates. Let me lay out how I'm thinking about the rebate treatment so we can finalize the authorization.

Martin, I'd like the $240,000 rebate applied proportionally across the two tax classifications. That means the capitalized equipment basis would be reduced to approximately $3,252,000 and the implementation expense to approximately $2,008,000, preserving the original 62/38 split between the two categories. Please confirm you can update the tax classification on that basis.

Rhea, I want to confirm that the $1,200,000 allocation to backup-power and dual-site-failover work remains explicitly recorded in the authorization regardless of the rebate adjustment. That allocation is non-negotiable from a risk perspective.

Jonas, the two-tranche hardware release schedule and the $240,000 rebate will both be captured in the supplier release terms. The net cash outlay after the rebate would be $5,260,000 against the revised $5,500,000 project total.

If everyone can confirm their respective items on this basis, I'm prepared to authorize the project and release funds.
